actual_run.disposition: Preserve the failed run. Do not retry the scenario process and do not waive either integrity failure.

failure_diagnosis.contract_error: The reused V3 shadow used loadOperationalEdges(), while the actual scenario-only post-turn repair receives graph.edges from buildScenarioStartupState's canonical settlement graph.
failure_diagnosis.domain_mismatch: repairScenarioArtifactState passes its edges to computeFrontEdgesOsid and reconcileFinalSectorTruth. The canonical graph endpoints are settlement IDs such as S100013, while computeFrontEdgesOsid expects OSID endpoints such as op:banja_luka:banja_luka_2.

first_source_predicate.predicate: if (sideA === null || sideB === null || sideA === sideB) continue;
first_source_predicate.effect: Canonical SID endpoints are queried as OSIDs, so the OSID controller lookup yields null and every canonical edge is skipped. The retained actual post-repair state has zero war_front_edges_osid entries.

downstream_empty_geometry_predicate.effect: The fresh reconciliation installs an empty corps_front_sectors map; sector-derived membership for both target formations disappears.

two_target_transition.after_displace: Both remain assigned to sector:hvo_southeast_herzegovina:0 with unchanged location and fatigue.
two_target_transition.after_front_edges: Both remain assigned to sector:hvo_southeast_herzegovina:0 with unchanged location and fatigue; war_front_edges_osid is now empty under the mismatched canonical-edge/OSID computation.
two_target_transition.after_reconcile: Both sector_ids arrays become empty with unchanged location and fatigue.
two_target_transition.causal_chain: Canonical SID graph supplied to OSID front-edge computation -> all edges rejected at the null-controller predicate -> empty OSID front edge set -> full geometry reconciliation returns and installs empty sectors -> both target memberships are erased.
two_target_transition.operational_graph_contrast: The retained wrong-domain V3 shadow using operational edges kept both formations assigned through displacement, front-edge recomputation, and reconciliation.

smallest_evidence_backed_proposal.proposal: Resolve the scenario-only post-turn repair boundary as one canon decision. If the extra repair remains, supply the operational contact edges expected by computeFrontEdgesOsid and reconcileFinalSectorTruth, matching the public war-phase edge domain. Also consider retiring or narrowing the extra full rebuild because the public turn pipeline already reconciles and then performs final brigade distribution/sealing; do not implement either option until canon establishes whether post-turn reconstruction is required.
smallest_evidence_backed_proposal.required_targeted_acceptance: On a retained or minimal deterministic state, the chosen boundary must preserve the final distribution/seal result and must not erase the two target memberships through an edge-domain mismatch. Full calibration or gameplay tuning is outside this scope.

claim_limits: The V4 actual generation did not pass its integrity contract and cannot support the planned automatic capture claim.
The offline result proves the artifact-side graph-argument mismatch and exact two-target causal chain for the retained T1 state only.

It does not decide whether the extra scenario repair is canonically required, establish a global gameplay fix, authorize implementation, or justify tuning, baseline, native, campaign, suite, or package work.
